alchemistaccelerator-siro:ashbyhq:1a190e.description: Field sales powers the economy — but most teams are struggling. We started as an AI-powered coaching platform that helped reps improve their outcomes in the field. Our platform integrates with systems like Salesforce, analyzing thousands of in-person sales conversations to surface insights, automate workflows, and drive better outcomes across the org. labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:77ce9cb6-af08-.description: Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model. Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint). We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. ABOUT THE ROLE: You'll own the day-to-day of our finance function: leading the accounting team, ensuring clean monthly closes, and delivering the numbers leadership needs to make decisions. Beyond the books, you'll be the person redesigning our processes, optimizing Microsoft Dynamics, and championing AI tools to eliminate manual work across the department. RESPONSABILITIES: - Own monthly, quarterly, and annual closes with accuracy and speed. - Prepare financial statements under Spanish GAAP (PGC) and deliver clear reporting and KPIs to leadership. - Manage AP/AR, treasury, payroll reconciliation, and tax compliance. - Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory bodies. - Design and implement internal controls and scalable financial processes. - Optimize Microsoft Dynamics to automate workflows and reduce close times. - Champion AI-driven tools across data entry, anomaly detection, and forecasting. ABOUT YOU: Academic Background - Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field. - Master's degree or certifications (CPA, ACCA, or Spanish equivalent) are a strong plus. What We Are Looking For - 5+ years in accounting or finance, with 1-2+ years leading a team. - Deep knowledge of Spanish PGC and tax regulations. - Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics. - Proven track record adopting AI tools or automation in financial workflows. - Experience in fast-paced environments (scale-ups, tech) is highly valued. - Builder mindset: you take ownership, ship fast, and don't wait for direction. Communication - Spanish fluent, English advanced. - Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both with financial and non-financial stakeholders, distilling complex information into actionable messages. Nice to Have - Familiarity with AI-powered finance software (automated invoicing, expense management, smart forecasting). - Experience implementing internal controls from the ground up in a growing company. WHAT WE OFFER - Attractive compensation, above market average. - Hybrid work model from our Barcelona office. - A high-ownership role with direct impact on how we scale. - The chance to build the finance function of a profitable, fast-growing startup. - A team of builders who ship products used by hundreds of thousands of people. HIRING PROCESS 1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition. 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager. 3. Technical case / assessment. 4. Final interview with founders. YOU SHOULD KNOW: Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them. Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.
